key_insight: Surface reactions reshape solute dispersion in tube flow, producing pre-asymptotic enhanced drift, reduced dispersivity, and non-Gaussian concentration profiles.
engineering_relevance: The model can inform transport predictions in flow reactors, liquid–solid chromatography, and fluidic devices with interphase mass transfer.
method: Extend streamwise dispersion theory to first-order, irreversible surface reactions.
Link microscopic reactivity and radial eigenmodes to an effective local exchange rate.
Derive explicit transport solutions and small- and large-Damköhler-number asymptotics.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports quantitative agreement with numerical simulations across all reactivity regimes, but provides no error metrics.
watch_item: Applicability to turbulent flows, complex geometries, or nonlinear surface kinetics is not established by the abstract.
paper_title: Streamwise dispersion with interphase mass transfer through a tube
